executive_summary.summary:
Disney+ achieved exceptional results on LG Ad Solutions during FY25 H1 (April-September 2026) across EMEA markets, investing $3.8M to generate 315M impressions, reach 20M unique users, and drive 2.6M proxy conversions at an efficient $2.79 cost per conversion. The campaign demonstrated significant improvement over the previous half, with H1 showing +63% more proxy conversions, +20% greater reach, and 34% better cost efficiency compared to H2.

Strategic evolution was evident in the shift from static creative (98% in H2) to dynamic video formats (34% Video Companion, 6% 4D Animated in H1), which consistently delivered 61% higher CTR and 105% higher launch rates. High-impact placements proved exceptionally effective, with Home Screen Roadblocks representing just 17% of spend but delivering 30% of total reach and 4x better cost efficiency. Content Store Roadblocks in UK and Germany achieved 3-5x higher CTR and launch rates versus benchmarks.

A critical opportunity exists in the 68-72% of active LG TVs across EMEA that don't have Disney+ installed, representing significant untapped potential. The successful rollout of Heavy Active suppression targeting to 92% of EU markets improved reach and efficiency, while lapsed user targeting at $5.22 CPE showed strong re-engagement potential across secondary markets.
key_wins: Delivered 2.6M proxy conversions at $2.79 CPE with $3.8M investment, achieving 34% cost efficiency improvement versus previous half
Reached 20M unique users (30%+ of addressable LG TV audience) with 315M impressions across EMEA markets
Home Screen Roadblocks delivered 4x better cost per proxy conversion efficiency while generating 30% of total reach with only 17% of budget
Content Store Roadblocks in UK/Germany achieved 3-5x higher CTR and launch rates, proving highly effective for app acquisition
Successfully transitioned creative strategy from 98% static to 66% static, with Video Companion formats delivering 61% higher CTR and 105% higher launch rates
areas_for_improvement: 68-72% of active LG TVs across EMEA markets remain without Disney+ installed, representing significant untapped acquisition opportunity
Static carousel creative still dominates at 66% of assets despite video formats showing superior performance across all KPIs
Lapsed user segment represents 69% of Disney+ installers (+2ppt growth), indicating retention challenges requiring targeted re-engagement
Limited geographic expansion of high-performing tactics like Content Store Roadblocks, which only ran in 4-6 markets despite proven 3-5x performance lift
recommendations: Expand lapsed user ROS targeting investment across all EMEA markets to convert the 69% lapsed installer base back to active users at the proven $5.22 CPE
Prioritize Carousel Companion with Video creative format to capitalize on 61% CTR lift and 105% launch rate improvement versus static assets
Scale Content Store Roadblocks to all available EMEA markets beyond UK/Germany, leveraging the proven 3-5x CTR and launch rate performance
Increase Home Screen Roadblock investment on key dates across all EMEA markets, given 4x cost efficiency and 30% reach delivery with 17% budget allocation
Implement Heavy Active suppression targeting as standard across all markets to improve reach efficiency and reduce wasted impressions on already-engaged users
next_steps: Secure high-impact placement holds for Content Store and Home Screen Roadblocks on key FY26 dates before competitors lock inventory
Finalize FY26 A/B testing agenda and confirm Bundle test priorities for early fiscal year execution
Develop video creative production pipeline to increase Video Companion and 4D Animated asset mix from current 34% to 60%+ of portfolio
Launch Content Notification Beta in Australia (December) and US (December-March) to test real-time engagement capabilities
Expand lapsed targeting budget allocation by 40-50% in Q1 FY26 to capitalize on 69% lapsed installer opportunity across all markets
